passageHtml:
Riverdale Community Museum

Local Objects Week: Recommendations and Student Guides Wanted

From 3 to 10 August, the museum will display everyday objects that tell stories about life in different parts of the world. Objects will be shown in the main gallery all week. On the final afternoon, student guides will introduce selected objects to families.

We welcome recommendations of safe, portable objects made before 2015. Each object should be small enough to fit inside a 40 cm display case. If you volunteer as a guide and complete the training session, you will receive a museum café voucher.

  • Recommendation period: 1 June-12 July
  • Maximum insured value: £80
  • Objects may be handmade or commercially produced.

Your Online Form

ObjectYearValueComment
Wooden lunch box1998£35Made by my grandfather; used on mountain trips.
Solar radio2018£45Used during power cuts; works without batteries.
Festival mask2006£70Light, handmade, and worn in a local summer dance.
Stone cooking pot1985£60Traditional family pot; weighs 18 kilograms.

Will you volunteer as a student guide? No

Email from the Museum

Thank you for your recommendations. Two objects meet all exhibition conditions and have been accepted. One object is too recent, while another cannot be placed safely in our standard case. We would also be grateful if you reconsidered helping as a guide; several international families have registered for the final afternoon. You may also send one additional recommendation before the deadline.

Attachment: Exhibition Review Notes

Wooden lunch box: Accepted. The personal history is clear, the object is easy to display, and its size is suitable for the case.

Solar radio: Not accepted for the main exhibition because of the date condition. The museum may consider it for a future event about emergency technology.

Festival mask: Accepted. Staff would like a short explanation of the dance and the materials used to make the mask.

Stone cooking pot: Not accepted. Although its age and value are suitable, its weight creates a risk when staff move the display case.

The museum selects objects not because they are rare or expensive but because visitors can understand a larger story through them. For this reason, a simple object with a strong explanation may be preferred to an unusual object with little background information.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of Local Objects Week?
options: To sell valuable antiques to visitors
To use ordinary objects to introduce ways of life
To train professional museum workers
To collect only handmade objects from students
questions.answer: To use ordinary objects to introduce ways of life
questions.evidence: everyday objects that tell stories about life
questions.reason_ja: 日用品を通して各地の生活を紹介する催しです。

questions.question: Which statement about volunteers is true?
options: They must bring an object worth over £80.
They will guide families on every day of the event.
They can receive a voucher after completing training.
They may skip the training if they speak English.
questions.answer: They can receive a voucher after completing training.
questions.evidence: complete the training session, you will receive a museum café voucher
questions.reason_ja: 研修を完了した案内役にはカフェ券が渡されます。

questions.question: Which two objects were most likely accepted?
options: Wooden lunch box and solar radio
Wooden lunch box and festival mask
Solar radio and stone cooking pot
Festival mask and stone cooking pot
questions.answer: Wooden lunch box and festival mask
questions.evidence: Two objects meet all exhibition conditions
questions.reason_ja: 1998・£35・小型の弁当箱と、2006・£70・軽い仮面が条件を満たします。

questions.question: Why was the solar radio rejected?
options: It was made after the required year.
It was too expensive to insure.
It was not commercially produced.
It needed batteries to operate.
questions.answer: It was made after the required year.
questions.reason_ja: 2018年製なので「2015年より前」という条件を満たしません。

questions.question: What two actions does the museum ask you to consider?
options: Buy a larger display case
Volunteer as a guide
Recommend another object
Translate the exhibition labels
questions.reason_ja: 案内役の再検討と追加推薦の二つですが、この設問では案内役を問います。
